blocks.text: Wrangler Tote Bag for Women Zipper Shoulder Handbag

items: Wrangler by Montana West bags for women designed for the modern explorer.
Whipstitch design adds a touch of western flair to this Wrangler tote, a special combination of wildness and elegance.
The women's bags are equipped with upgraded hardware and a sturdy zipper, ensuring its durability for prolonged use.
Adjustable and detachable strap allows for comfortable wear as a crossbody bag or a shoulder bag, making women's tote bag easy to carry your belongings with you on the go.

items.value: Wipe clean with a damp cloth for spot cleaning. Do not machine wash or dry clean.
